scenes.caption: Welcome to the Physics World
scenes.vo: Assalam-o-alaikum, and welcome. I'm Syed Jabran Ali Kamran. This is our Physics learning ecosystem — one place where your classes, practice, progress and guidance come together. Let me walk you through it.

scenes.caption: Install the app · Remember your login
scenes.vo: Start by installing the portal as an app on your phone, tablet or laptop. When you open it, tap Install — and from then on it opens like any other app, with real-time alerts. On the sign-in screen you can ask your device to remember your email, so getting back in is quick and simple.

scenes.caption: Your dashboard
scenes.vo: This is your dashboard — your home base. At a glance you see what needs your attention today: your next class, pending tasks, new announcements, and your personalised study plan, all in one view.

scenes.caption: Physics timetable
scenes.vo: Your Physics timetable shows every scheduled class for your own school, class, level and group — in Pakistan time. Regular classes and any extra classes appear here automatically, and you can sync them straight to your Google Calendar with reminders.

scenes.caption: Exam Lab
scenes.vo: The Exam Lab is where you practise and sit tests — topical drills, full past papers, and proctored class tests. Multiple-choice papers are marked automatically the moment you submit, so you get your result instantly.

scenes.caption: Review your answer scripts
scenes.vo: Every paper you attempt is saved. Open My Answer Scripts to review exactly what you answered, the correct answers, your marks and the feedback — so every attempt becomes a lesson, not just a score.

scenes.caption: Personalised weekly study plan
scenes.vo: This is the heart of it — your personalised weekly study plan. Based on your ranking and your real performance, the portal identifies your weak topics and builds a gradual path for you: targeted reading, a video lesson, an interactive simulation, a short written assignment, and a diagnostic test — with a daily challenge to keep you sharp.

scenes.caption: Real-time alerts
scenes.vo: You'll never miss anything important. Announcements, upcoming tests, scheduled classes, daily tasks and challenges all arrive as real-time alerts — in the app, and as notifications on your device even when the app is closed.

scenes.caption: Resource library
scenes.vo: The resource library is our shared space. Download study material, and engage with what others share — like, react and comment — so we learn together as one community.

scenes.caption: Ranking & leaderboard
scenes.vo: A little healthy competition helps. The leaderboard ranks you in your class, your school and the whole network — privately, under a call-sign, unless you choose to show your name.

scenes.caption: Let's begin
scenes.vo: That's your portal — built to guide you, topic by topic, towards real results in Cambridge Physics. Install it, turn on your alerts, and let's begin. I'll see you inside.
